campus_notes: Compiled 2026-11-26 from Academy of Art University's Department of Housing & Residence Life: the Housing Overview (academyart.edu/academy-life/housing-dining/), the official Fall 2026-Spring 2027 housing rate sheet (halls, addresses, room types, codes and persons per room) and Preparing for Your Arrival (furniture). The university publishes no room dimensions, square footage or floor plans, so every room here uses the site's estimate fallback (a representative ft x ft derived from similar rooms across the dataset) and is labelled as an estimate. There is no enclosed campus: the four residence halls are separate buildings in downtown San Francisco (Union Square and Lower Nob Hill, no more than about 600 m apart), and free ArtU shuttles link them with the academic buildings across the city. Clara Gil Stephens (620 Sutter) is the first-year hall and requires a meal plan; the other three are apartment-style halls for upper-class and graduate students. Beds are standard twin, not Twin XL, and most are bunk beds; lofted beds are prohibited. Air conditioning is not mentioned, and air conditioners are on the prohibited-items list.

dorms.notes: The only hall open to first-year students on the Fall 2026-Spring 2027 rate sheet (also upper-class and graduate students). Meal plan required. Fitness center and dining hall in the building; it also houses the Department of Housing & Residence Life and an ArtU shuttle stop (620/860 Sutter).
